segments.speaker: surveyor
segments.text: Hi. I was just a test, honestly. Nobody knew if the Moon was solid or if you'd sink right into it, so they sent me first.

segments.speaker: surveyor
segments.text: That's it. That's it. Let's see if that counts.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: Armstrong stepped onto solid ground because you were first and proved it wouldn't swallow him.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: You're just a tiny tripod with a camera.

segments.speaker: surveyor
segments.text: I didn't think of it that way.
